paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: : Ablation studies on n-best candidates generations (Beam search and Sampling search) on valid set of WMT15 De-En.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the relationship between Average Lagging (AL) and BLEU scores for different models. The x-axis is labeled "Average Lagging (AL)" and spans the range from 2.5 to 12.5, with tick marks appearing at intervals of 2.5 units. The y-axis is labeled "BLEU" and ranges from 24 to 31, with regularly spaced tick marks. A blue, dashed line with circular markers represents "Inconsistency-CE", starting at a BLEU score of approximately 23.8 at AL 2.5 and increasing to approximately 29.4 at AL 12.5. An orange, dashed line with triangular markers represents "Consistency-Bi +sampling ", starting at a BLEU score of approximately 27.7 at AL 2.5 and increasing to approximately 30.5 at AL 12.5. A green, dashed line with square markers represents "Consistency-Bi +beam", beginning at approximately 28.0 at AL 2.5, increasing to a peak of approximately 29.4 at AL 7.5, and then decreasing and ending at approximately 30.7 at AL 12.5.
